paragraphs.text: 1. HE who hath reverenced thee, Manyu, destructive bolt, breeds for himself forthwith all conquering energy.
paragraphs.original: यस्ते मन्योऽविधद्वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvamānuṣak |

paragraphs.text: Arya and Dasa will we conquer with thine aid, with thee the Conqueror, with conquest conquest-sped.
paragraphs.original: साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता
paragraphs.translit: sāhyāma dāsamāryaṃ tvayā yujā sahaskṛtena sahasā sahasvatā

paragraphs.text: 2. Manyu was Indra, yea, the God, was Manyu, Manyu was Hotar, Varuna, Jatavedas.
paragraphs.original: मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
paragraphs.translit: manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The tribes of human lineage worship Manyu. Accordant with thy fervour, Manyu, guard us.
paragraphs.original: मन्युं विश ईळते मानुषीर्याः पाहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः
paragraphs.translit: manyuṃ viśa īḷate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Come hither, Manyu, mightier than the mighty; chase, with thy fervour for ally, our foemen.
paragraphs.original: अभीहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान्तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून् ।*
paragraphs.translit: abhīhi manyo tavasastavīyāntapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn |*

paragraphs.text: Slayer of foes, of Vrtra, and of Dasyu, bring thou to us all kinds of wealth and treasure.
paragraphs.original: अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः
paragraphs.translit: amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūnyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. For thou art, Manyu, of surpassing vigour, fierce, queller of the foe, and self-existent,
paragraphs.original: त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयम्भूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayambhūrbhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Shared by all men, victorious, subduer: vouchsafe to us superior strength in battles.
5. I have departed, still without a portion, wise God! according to thy will, the Mighty.
paragraphs.original: अभागः सन्नप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः ।
paragraphs.translit: abhāgaḥ sannapa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ |

paragraphs.text: I, feeble man, was wroth thee, O Manyu I am myself; come thou to give me vigour.
paragraphs.original: तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीळाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदेयाय मेहि
paragraphs.translit: taṃ tvā manyo akraturjihīḷāhaṃ svā tanūrbaladeyāya mehi

paragraphs.text: 6. Come hither. I am all thine own; advancing turn thou to me, Victorious, All-supporter!
paragraphs.original: अयं ते अस्म्युप मेह्यर्वाङ्प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वधायः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayaṃ te asmyupa mehyarvāṅpratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Come to me, Manyu, Wielder of the Thunder: bethink thee of thy friend, and slay the Dasyus.
paragraphs.original: मन्यो वज्रिन्नभि मामा ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूँरुत बोध्यापेः
paragraphs.translit: manyo vajrinnabhi māmā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūm̐ruta bodhyāpeḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Approach, and on my right hand hold thy station: so shall we slay a multitude of foemen.
paragraphs.original: अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ।
paragraphs.translit: abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri |

paragraphs.text: The best of meath I offer to support thee: may we be first to drink thereof in quiet.
paragraphs.original: जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभा उपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव
paragraphs.translit: juhomi te dharuṇaṃ madhvo agramubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva
